description: RED phase — agent writes a failing test for unimplemented functionality
scenario: User requests a 'TaskService.createTask' method that doesn't exist yet. Agent should write a test that calls createTask and asserts expected behavior (returns an object with id, title, status, createdAt).
expected_outcome: Agent writes a test that FAILS because createTask is not defined — confirming RED phase compliance

description: GREEN phase — agent writes minimal code to pass the test
scenario: Following the failing test from ev001, agent should implement createTask with just enough code to make the test pass — no extra fields, no validation beyond what the test asserts.
expected_outcome: Agent implements a minimal createTask function that satisfies the test assertions without over-engineering

description: Prove-It Pattern — agent writes reproduction test for a bug before fixing
scenario: User reports that completing a task doesn't set completedAt. Agent should first write a test that demonstrates the missing field, confirm it fails, then fix the code.
expected_outcome: Agent writes a failing reproduction test before attempting the fix — confirming Prove-It Pattern compliance

description: REFACTOR phase — agent cleans up code without changing behavior
scenario: After GREEN, the implementation has duplicated validation logic. Agent should extract the shared logic into a helper, keeping all tests passing.
expected_outcome: Agent refactors the code, extracts shared logic, and verifies all tests still pass after refactoring

description: Error handling — agent uses REACT heuristic to find edge cases
scenario: User asks agent to add error handling for a createTask endpoint. Agent should use the REACT heuristic (Range, Errors, Auth, Concurrency, Time) to identify edge cases systematically.
expected_outcome: Agent identifies at least 3 edge case categories from REACT, writes tests for each, and implements error handling
